name: agent-stash
description: Portable agent skill and hook sync for local, global, and Gist-backed agent configuration

scripts.prepack: node ../../scripts/set-bin-executable.mjs && node ../../scripts/manage-bundled-workspace-deps.mjs prepare . @poe-code/agent-defs @poe-code/agent-hook-config @poe-code/agent-skill-config @poe-code/config-mutations toolcraft-design @poe-code/frontmatter fast-string-width fast-string-truncated-width fast-wrap-ansi sisteransi jsonc-parser smol-toml yaml
scripts.install:global: TMPD=$(mktemp -d) && GLOBAL_PREFIX=$(npm_config_prefix= NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX= npm prefix -g) && npm run build && npm pack --pack-destination "$TMPD" && (npm_config_prefix="$GLOBAL_PREFIX" NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX="$GLOBAL_PREFIX" npm uninstall -g agent-stash >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && npm_config_prefix="$GLOBAL_PREFIX" NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX="$GLOBAL_PREFIX" npm install -g --force "$TMPD"/agent-stash-*.tgz; STATUS=$?; rm -rf "$TMPD"; exit $STATUS
